results.title: Talking Korean cinema in France
results.description: President Lee Jae Myung met with South Korean film directors and actors during his state visit to France on Monday. Lee met with the cast of director Lee Chang-dong's "Possible Love," including actors Sul Kyung-gu, Jeon Do-yeon and Kim Do-yeon, as well as other leading figures in Korea's entertainment industry, including Kim Min-young, vice president of content for Asia at Netflix. results.title: 'Bethlehem Kudumba Unit' box office collections day 18: Nivin Pauly film sees 54.3% drop
results.description: Bethlehem Kudumba Unit's third week collections remain robust, earning Rs 3.70 crore on its eighteenth day. The film has achieved a significant worldwide gross of Rs 270.45 crore after eighteen days. Its India net collection stands at Rs 127.10 crore, showing sustained audience interest. Overseas markets also contributed Rs 122.00 crore to the film's total earnings. Kerala led state-wise gross earnings, contributing Rs 3.35 crore on day eighteen.

results.title: Day6 to host fan meetups in October
results.description: Day6 is planning to hold its fifth round of fan meetings for three days in Incheon, JYP Entertainment announced Monday. The four bandmates will meet and greet fans at the event, “Every Day6, Every My Day,” at Inspire Arena from Oct. 23-25. The last day’s meetup will be livestreamed as well. The upcoming gig will see the quartet reuniting with fans about three months since it wrapped up “The Decade” tour, which marked its 10th year and fourth studio album of the same title.
